steps.text: Your mission: place digits into the boxes to make the sum or difference as big (or as small) as the mission asks.
Tap any digit to drop it into the next box (you choose which).
Keep tapping digits to fill every box. Made a mistake? Tap “Backspace” to undo.
When all boxes are full, tap “Check” to see if you beat the mission.
Tap “Reset” to clear and try a smarter arrangement.
The trick: put big digits in the highest place values to make bigger numbers — that's how you win the duel.

coach.mission: Arrange digits to beat the mission's target.
whenStuck: Tap digits to fill the boxes, then tap “Check”.
Bigger digits in the leftmost boxes make a bigger number.
whenWrong: Place value is the key — the leftmost box counts most. Put big digits there for a bigger number (small digits for a smaller one).
Re-read the mission: does it want the biggest or the smallest result?
whenCorrect: You beat the duel! Nicely arranged.
Great place-value thinking — try to win in fewer moves.
coach.done: You've mastered arranging digits by place value. Keep dueling, or move on.

steps.text: Tap “Reset” to clear the boxes for a fresh round.
Read the mission at the top — biggest or smallest? Then place digits by place value: big digits in the leftmost boxes for a big number, small digits left for a small one.
When every box is filled, tap “Check”.

onCorrect: Yes! Bigger digits in the higher place values make a bigger number.
Place value decides a number's size — you matched the mission exactly.
Sharp arranging! You beat the duel again.
onWrong: Not the best yet — the leftmost box is worth the most, so put your biggest digit there (smallest for a small number). Tap Reset and rearrange.
Re-read the mission: does it want the biggest or the smallest result? Then order the digits to match.
practice.done: You've mastered arranging digits by place value — you can build the biggest or smallest number on demand!
